## 1. Cursor pagination

I counted an endpoint when it accepts `start_cursor` or `cursor` and returns `next_cursor`.

**Main API (`https://api.notion.com`)**

| Endpoint | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| List all users | GET | `/v1/users` |
| Retrieve a page property item | GET | `/v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id}` |
| Retrieve block children | GET | `/v1/blocks/{block_id}/children` |
| Query a data source | POST | `/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query` |
| List data source templates | GET | `/v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/templates` |
| Search by title | POST | `/v1/search` |
| List comments | GET | `/v1/comments` |
| List file uploads | GET | `/v1/file_uploads` |
| List custom emojis | GET | `/v1/custom_emojis` |
| List views | GET | `/v1/views` |
| Get view query results | GET | `/v1/views/{view_id}/queries/{query_id}` |
| Query agents | POST | `/v1/agents/query` |
| List skills plugins | GET | `/v1/ai/plugins` |
| Query sessions | POST | `/v1/sessions/query` |
| Query session events | POST | `/v1/sessions/{session_id}/events/query` |

Two endpoints have `next_cursor` in the response but accept no cursor input, so I left them out. They are Append block children (`PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children`) and Create a view query (`POST /v1/views/{view_id}/queries`). For the view query, you page through results with Get view query results.

**Admin API (`https://api.notion.com/admin/v1`)**

| Endpoint | Method | Path |
|---|---|---|
| List analytics reports | GET | `/v1/analytics/reports` |
| List legal holds | GET | `/v1/legal_holds` |
| List users on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/users` |
| List workspaces on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/workspaces` |
| List pages on a legal hold | GET | `/v1/legal_holds/{legal_hold_id}/spaces/{space_id}/pages` |
| List MCP client connections | GET | `/v1/mcp_client_connections` |
| List groups | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups` |
| List users | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/users` |
| List group members | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/groups/{group_id}/members` |
| List personal access tokens | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/personal_access_tokens` |

| Get credit usage for one agent | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/credit_usage` |
| Get an agent's sharing permissions | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/agents/{agent_id}/permissions` |

The three agent endpoints (agents, credit usage, permissions) name the parameter `cursor`, not `start_cursor`.

## 2. Deprecated or replaced

| Endpoint | Method | Path | Deprecated | Replacement | Version |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| List MCP client connections (Admin) | GET | `/v1/mcp_client_connections` | `cursor` query param | `start_cursor` | Not stated in the spec |
| List personal access tokens (Admin) | GET | `/v1/spaces/{space_id}/personal_access_tokens` | `cursor` query param | `start_cursor` | Not stated in the spec |
| Append block children | PATCH | `/v1/blocks/{block_id}/children` | `after` body param | `position` object (`after_block`, `start`, `end`) | 2026-03-11 |
| Update page, and any request or response that carries it | PATCH | `/v1/pages/{page_id}` | `archived` field | `in_trash` | Deprecated April 2024; removed in 2026-03-11 |
| Blocks (Retrieve, Update, Append, and others) | – | – | `transcription` block type | `meeting_notes` | 2026-03-11 |
| Update a page's content as markdown | PATCH | `/v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown` | `insert_content` and `replace_content_range` commands (marked `deprecated: true` in the spec) | `update_content` or `replace_content` | Not stated in the spec |
| Post database query | POST | `/v1/databases/{database_id}/query` | Query on a database ID | Query a data source: `POST /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query` | 2025-09-03 |
| Update database (properties) and Update database properties (legacy) | PATCH | `/v1/databases/{database_id}` | Property changes made through the database | Update a data source: `PATCH /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}` | 2025-09-03 |
| Create a database | POST | `/v1/databases` | Initial property schema in the request | Create a data source | 2025-09-03 |
| Relation properties (all database and data-source writes) | – | – | `database_id` in the request | `data_source_id` only | 2025-09-03 |
| Search by title | POST | `/v1/search` | `filter.value = "database"` | `"data_source"` | 2025-09-03 |
| List databases | GET | `/v1/databases` | Whole endpoint | Search with `filter.value = "data_source"` or `"page"` | Removed in 2022-02-22 |

- **Legacy endpoint pages:** the legacy pages (`get-databases`, `post-database-query`, `update-property-schema-object`) are in the docs index but not in the OpenAPI spec. For those I relied on the upgrade guides.
